business_description.value: Artivion, Inc. manufactures, processes, and distributes medical devices and implantable human tissues worldwide. historical_forecast_error.eligibility_note: Each observation is the consensus on the eve of the result — lead time ~0 — so it measures last-mile surprise: a cross-check on scenario severity and on how wrong late consensus has been. It is NOT a distribution of how far consensus moves over a holding period; that needs point-in-time consensus snapshots, which no Estimates Report carries.
historical_forecast_error.usage_note: EBIT- or EBITDA-level shock today: error_per_forecast_revenue × today's revenue consensus. Revenue × margin scenario: the SAME year's Revenue pct_error and ratio_error, kept together. ratio_error alone answers how wrong the margin (or capex-intensity) forecast was, and multiplied by revenue it drops the revenue miss's effect. Exact identity: error_per_forecast_revenue = ratio_error + (actual ÷ actual revenue) × (actual revenue ÷ forecast revenue − 1).
